headlines.headline: Reliance Q2 results: Net profit jumps 41% YoY to ₹25,548 crore; O2C revenues surge 44% on higher energy prices
headlines.summary: Reliance Industries posted a strong 41% YoY growth in its Q2 profits, with major support from the strong revenue gains in the O2C segment due to elevated crude oil prices in the market during the September quarter.

headlines.headline: Reliance Retail Q2 results: RIL vertical’s profit drops 24.5% YoY to ₹2,619 crore, JioMart revenue grows 42%
headlines.summary: Reliance Retail Q2 results: Its revenue from operations advanced by 5.8% YoY to ₹80,220 crore in Q2 FY27, compared with ₹75,836 crore in the year-ago period.

headlines.headline: RIL Q2 results: JioStar Business PAT declines 13% YoY; monthly active users rise to 440 million
headlines.summary: The quarter marked the relaunch and rebranding of JioStar’s digital destination as ‘JioHotstar’ in the international markets of Singapore, the UK and Canada.

headlines.headline: SENSEX rises over 300 points, NIFTY50 reclaims 23,000 led by Infosys, HDFC Bank
headlines.summary: Infosys, HDFC Bank, ICICI Bank, Trent, InterGlobe Aviation, Eternal and NTPC were top movers during the session.

headlines.headline: Reliance Q2 results: Net profit likely to see up to 20% YoY growth driven by recovery in O2C business and strong refining margins
headlines.summary: Reliance Industries will announce its Q2FY27 results on Friday, October 30, days after the listing of Jio Platforms. Experts expect double-digit growth in revenue, profit and EBITDA, led by a recovery in the oil-to-chemicals business, strong refining margins and a weaker rupee.

headlines.headline: GIFT NIFTY futures indicate weak opening for Indian markets amid weak global markets

headlines.headline: Stocks to watch, Oct 30: Jio Platforms, Reliance Industries, Trent, IndiGo, IT stocks, IEX, Vedanta Group, PB Fintech
headlines.summary: Reliance Industries (RIL), India's most valuable company, is scheduled to announce its financial results for the quarter ended September 30, 2026 (Q2 FY27), today. Analysts expect the conglomerate to report strong numbers, driven primarily by a recovery in its oil-to-chemicals (O2C) business.

headlines.headline: Stocks to watch, Oct 29: Asian Paints, Meesho, Hero MotoCorp, Milky Mist, Coal India, Trent, IndiGo, GMR Airports
headlines.summary: E-commerce firm Meesho on Wednesday reported a narrowing of loss to ₹132.4 crore in the second quarter ended September. The company had posted a loss of ₹411.3 crore in the same period a year ago.

headlines.headline: Top gainers and losers, Oct 28: Infosys, RIL shares fall 3%; Apollo Hospitals, L&T gain 4%
headlines.summary: On October 28, the SENSEX declined by 352.64 points or 0.48% to close at 73,246.03. Similarly, the NIFTY50 ended lower by 50.90 points or 0.22% at 22,698.85.

headlines.headline: Market wrap today: SENSEX ends 350 pts lower, NIFTY50 closes at 22,698; IT stocks, Reliance among top losers
headlines.summary: The NIFTY50 and SENSEX ended lower on October 28, as investors focused on the weak global market cues and elevated oil prices ahead of the US Federal Reserve's policy meeting outcome.

headlines.headline: Jio Platforms extends rally, tops ₹1,400, trades 27% above issue price; key data points to know
headlines.summary: The Reliance Industries (RIL)-backed digital services company began trading at ₹1,358 apiece on both the BSE and NSE, up 21.36% from its IPO issue price of ₹1,119. Later in the session, the stock extended its gains, advancing as much as 25.52% to ₹1,404.60 on the NSE.
